Issue: P0-5: GA4 (VITE_GA4_ID) + GSC verification env vars were unset, so tracking/verification tags were omitted
Recommendation: Set VITE_GA4_ID=G-ZBGQL8K61D in Vercel (Config) + local .env; redeploy.

Issue: 169 pages "Discovered - currently not indexed" (up from 4 in July) after mass launch of ~592 pages on a low-authority domain
Recommendation: Stop scaling page count. Prune/consolidate near-duplicate location pages; keep only cities with real demand. Build backlinks/authority. Submit priority pages via Indexing API and request indexing for money pages.
Impact: Very high — most pages get no traffic

Issue: Organic impressions collapsed from ~156/day (early July) to single digits (August) correlating with mass page rollout
Recommendation: Treat as quality-dilution signal. Focus crawl budget on 30-40 high-value pages; deprioritise thin near-template pages; improve E-E-A-T (author bios, sources, real project proof).

Issue: CTR ~0 on pages ranking well: /blog/ibr-certification-guide 883 impr @ pos 16 = 4 clicks
Recommendation: Rewrite title/meta to match queries (ibr certification, ibr full form, ibr form iii-c); add answer snippet + FAQ; add number/year hooks.

Issue: ss-flange-types-guide 490 impr @ pos 9.9 but only 2 clicks; sorf-vs-wnrf query at pos 7 with 0 clicks
Recommendation: Title/meta rewritten to lead with SORF vs WNRF. Still TODO: add comparison table high on page for featured-snippet capture.

Issue: IBR keyword cannibalisation across 4+ URLs (ibr-certification-guide, what-is-ibr-certification, ibr-form-iiic-complete-guide, why-ibr-certification-mandatory)
Recommendation: Designate one IBR pillar; retarget others to distinct long-tail intents or consolidate + 301. Internally link cluster to the pillar.

Issue: 100+ near-template location pages diluting quality signals and consuming crawl budget
Recommendation: Keep high-value cities (Vadodara belt + top industrial hubs); consolidate or noindex low-demand duplicates until authority grows.

Issue: No responsive images (no srcset/sizes); same large PNG served to mobile and desktop across /img-hq and /img
Recommendation: Add srcset/sizes; convert /img-hq and /img PNG/JPEG to WebP/AVIF; verify hero image weight for LCP.

Issue: Product schema lacks offers and aggregateRating on most product pages -> weak Product rich results (106 impr, 0 clicks)
Recommendation: Add offers (priceCurrency INR, availability) and aggregateRating where product reviews exist.

Issue: Mobile ranks pos 9.9 vs desktop 35.4 but only 731 mobile impr vs 3217 desktop — mobile strength underleveraged
Recommendation: Prioritise mobile UX and mobile page speed; ensure money pages are mobile-optimised to capitalise on stronger mobile ranking.

Issue: 1 page reports 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag' (validation Failed)
Recommendation: Identify the page in GSC; fix canonical to self-reference or accept intended canonical; re-validate.

Issue: LocalBusiness geo coordinates differ: home 22.3072,73.1812 vs app.tsx 22.2964,73.2055
Recommendation: Use one authoritative GeoCoordinates value matching Google Business Profile.

Issue: priceRange inconsistent (₹₹₹ sitewide vs $$/$$$ on some pages)
Recommendation: Standardise priceRange across all schema blocks.

Issue: Two LocalBusiness entities per page (#localbusiness + #business) — valid via distinct @id but redundant
Recommendation: Consolidate to one LocalBusiness entity referenced by @id; keep parentOrganization linkage.

Issue: ~17 URLs crawled returning noindex 404 — internal/external links point to dead pages
Recommendation: Run internal link-integrity sweep: compare every href='/...' to actual route files; fix or 301 legacy URLs.

Issue: Comparison guides may exist both in blog/[slug] ARTICLES map and as standalone files — duplicate/canonical risk
Recommendation: Audit for any slug resolving in both [slug] map and a standalone file; keep one, 301/remove the other.

Issue: Missing security headers: HSTS, Referrer-Policy, CSP, Permissions-Policy
Recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security and Referrer-Policy (low risk); scope CSP carefully.

Issue: Small muted-grey text (#9ca3af/#6b7280 on white) may fail WCAG AA contrast
Recommendation: Audit contrast; darken small secondary text to >=4.5:1.

Issue: Very large homepage DOM (18+ full sections) — INP/memory risk on low-end mobile
Recommendation: Consider deferring/lazy-mounting below-the-fold sections (news, mega link list).

Recommendation: Replace the broken replacement character with the intended emoji/icon or remove.

Issue: admin/reviews.tsx comment documents default token value 'cmi-admin-2026'
Recommendation: Remove the default-token value from the comment; keep ADMIN_TOKEN env-only.

Issue: Legacy 'keywords' meta tag present on some pages (ignored by Google)
Recommendation: Remove keywords meta for tidiness (optional).

Issue: Duplicate og:site_name / og:image declared in both app.tsx and page routes
Recommendation: Rely on site-wide values; remove page-level duplicates that repeat identical content.

Issue: No hreflang despite India + 50 export countries (en only)
Recommendation: Optional: add en-IN/en hreflang alternates if expanding international targeting.

Issue: Product-card alt text generic ('SS Seamless Pipe 1')
Recommendation: Make alt text descriptive (grade + product + context).

Issue: Dense pill links (0.78rem) close together — small tap targets on mobile
Recommendation: Increase tap target size/spacing on mobile.

Issue: Reviews auto-approved but message says 'appear after moderation' — misleading
Recommendation: Align UX copy with actual behaviour (auto-publish) or add real moderation.

Issue: .vercel/ and .venv/ appear committed to repo
Recommendation: Ensure build artefacts and virtualenvs are gitignored.
